U.A. Clubs.text: U.A. clubs meet after classes (about 16:00-19:00; swimming also before homeroom). This spring several were nearly empty, so first-years who cared stepped up to run them, fitting it around their own courses. Kendo: run by Itsuka Kendo, advisor Ectoplasm, Monday, Wednesday, Friday, the Main Gymnasium. Light Music: run by Kyoka Jiro, advisor Present Mic, Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, the Music Room. Choir: run by Ibara Shiozaki, advisor Nemuri Kayama, Monday, Wednesday, the Music Room. Robotics: run by Mei Hatsume, advisor Power Loader, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, the Development Studio's club bench. Cooking: run by Rikido Sato, advisor Lunch Rush, Thursday, the Other Course Common Kitchen. Tea Ceremony: run by Momo Yaoyorozu, advisor Cementoss, Wednesday, the Library's quiet rooms. Manga: run by Manga Fukidashi, advisor Present Mic, Tuesday, Friday, the Library's quiet rooms. Track and Field: run by Tenya Iida, advisor Vlad King, Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, the Athletics Field. Swimming: run by Tsuyu Asui, advisor Thirteen, Wednesday, the Indoor Pool. Basketball: run by Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, advisor Vlad King, Monday, Wednesday, Friday, the Main Gymnasium. Volleyball: run by Nejire Hado, advisor Nemuri Kayama, Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, the Main Gymnasium. Light Music and Choir share the Music Room on a booking sheet; Basketball, Volleyball and Kendo share the Main Gymnasium by schedule, which starts arguments. Any U.A. student may join up to two clubs. Hero Course members trade the afternoon for it: evening training and homework wait, and teachers notice a slipping grade. Leads run things when their own schedule allows; nobody is forced to attend.
